Subject: Urgent Legal Complaint Regarding Fraudulent Education Loan, False Placement Assurance & Recovery Harassment – Loan Amount ₹3,50,000

Dear Sir/Madam,

I, Ms. Archana Vangari, resident of Pune, hereby lodge a formal and urgent complaint against Bankage Institute and their loan processing partner Eduvanz Finance for fraudulent admission, false placement assurance, misuse of education loan, damage to my CIBIL score, and continuous mental harassment through recovery threats.

Background & Timeline:

In December 2022, I was approached by Bankage Institute for admission into a PGDM (External Mode) program. I was clearly assured that this program included job placement support.

I informed them clearly that:
•	I was not a fresher
•	I already had work experience
•	My expected salary package was above ₹3 LPA

They informed me that freshers usually receive only ₹3 LPA, so I initially declined the offer. However, despite my refusal, they still proceeded with my admission and processed an education loan of ₹3,50,000 through Eduvanz Finance, without my proper informed consent.

They clearly committed that:

“Your EMI will start only after you get a job placement.”

Serious Breach & Financial Impact:

Contrary to their promise:
•	I never received any job placement till date.
•	Still, my EMI of approximately ₹10,000 was deducted from the very first month.
•	Because of this violation, I immediately informed them that I do not wish to continue the program.
•	After this:
•	I was removed from all WhatsApp groups
•	Removed from all email communication
•	I stopped receiving any academic or placement-related updates

For several months, EMI payments were shown as managed internally. However, now after 11 months, Eduvanz Finance is showing delayed payment/default, which is seriously impacting my CIBIL score and financial reputation.

Harassment & Disappearance of Bankage Institute:
•	I am now receiving continuous threatening calls from recovery agents of Eduvanz Finance.
•	They are warning me of legal action, but are unable to clarify:
•	On what legal basis payment is being demanded
•	When placement was never provided
•	I have more than 50 contact numbers of Bankage Institute, but all numbers are switched off/unreachable.
•	I sent a legal notice through my advocate, but it was returned undelivered.
•	I have also filed a police complaint in Pune, but no action has been taken so far.
•	Now we are in 2025, and for almost 3 years I have received no job placement, no academic update, and no official communication from Bankage Institute.

Serious Legal Issues Involved:
•	The loan was approved based on false placement assurance
•	The institute has disappeared
•	My CIBIL score has been damaged without any fault of mine
•	I am facing continuous mental harassment
•	This clearly amounts to:
•	Fraud
•	Cheating
•	Misrepresentation
•	Deficiency of Service
•	Mental Harassment under Consumer Protection Act

My Formal Demands:
1.	Immediate written clarification on:
•	Why EMI started without placement
•	On what legal basis recovery action is being attempted
2.	Immediate correction of my CIBIL record
3.	Written confirmation of my course and placement status
4.	Immediate stoppage of threatening recovery calls
5.	Fixing legal responsibility on Bankage Institute for fraud and disappearance

Final Legal Intimation:

If I do not receive a proper written resolution within 7 working days, I shall be constrained to proceed with:
•	Consumer Court Case
•	RBI / NBFC Ombudsman Complaint
•	Cyber Crime Complaint
•	Criminal Case under IPC for Fraud & Cheating
•	Legal Action for Mental Harassment & Financial Defamation

This matter has caused me severe financial loss, emotional breakdown, and irreversible damage to my credit profile

I felt completely stuck and helpless dealing with this company. In the end, I had no option but to transfer my loan to IDFC Bank last year just to get out of this horrible experience.
If you are planning to study abroad and thinking about taking a loan from this company, please think again. Do not put yourself through this kind of stress, frustration, and complete lack of support.
